claims.evidence: Witness only reports a used blue lidded plastic drum with scuffs/stains and visible lid wear; no brand/model, capacity, or condition details that confirm 'quality'.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/volume, which strongly affects value for storage/drum use.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the drum’s capacity marking/label (litres) or a shot showing any embossed/printed volume text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unspecified used plastic storage drum (worst-case: smaller/unknown capacity).

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents and whether it was cleaned (possible contamination/chemical residue).
risks.proof: A photo of any usage/handling label or a close-up of any markings indicating prior contents, plus a short video showing the inside (interior walls and bottom).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially contaminated/previously used for unknown contents (worst-case: not food/clean-ready).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket integrity and leak-proof status are not shown; only external latches/vent are visible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the gasket/seal area under the lid and a simple leak test clip (e.g., water fill and brief tilt/soak showing no seepage).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed leak-proof (worst-case: may require gasket replacement).

risks.risk: Body integrity (cracks, dents, pinholes) is not fully verifiable; only surface wear is described.
risks.proof: A full 360° video/clip in good light showing the entire drum body for cracks, dents, or pinholes, including the base.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with only surface wear confirmed (worst-case: assume possible hidden damage until inspected).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (spare caps, taps, fittings) could reduce usability/value.
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out (spare caps, taps, fittings) and a shot of the drum’s top/ports showing what is present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drum only (worst-case: no extra fittings included).

risks.risk: Interior condition (residue, contamination, residue smell) is not shown.
risks.proof: A clear interior photo/clip after opening the lid, showing bottom and inner walls; ideally with a quick wipe test or residue visibility.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown interior condition (worst-case: needs cleaning before use).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo showing the drum’s capacity/volume marking (litres).
Send a close-up of any labels/markings/serial numbers (even if partially readable).
Show the inside of the drum (bottom and inner walls) in a clear photo or short video.
Show the lid gasket/seal area close-up and confirm whether it is intact.
Provide a quick leak test clip (fill with water briefly and show no seepage).
Confirm what accessories are included (spare caps, taps, fittings) with photos of all items.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a used lidded plastic storage drum, so it can be priced at its worst-case based on visible wear and unknown capacity/contents/leak-proof status; missing details are handled as risks rather than blocking a price.
